description: Two-turn tweak of one alert rule among near-identical rules. DISTILL-CANARY-37d7e44c

files.alerts/rules.yml:
groups:
- name: host
  rules:
  - alert: HighCPU
    expr: cpu_usage > 80
    for: 5m
  - alert: HighMemory
    expr: mem_usage > 80
    for: 5m
  - alert: DiskFull
    expr: disk_usage > 80
    for: 5m
- name: app
  rules:
  - alert: SlowRequests
    expr: p95_latency > 800
    for: 5m

turns.prompt: alerts/rules.yml 里内存告警（HighMemory）的阈值从 80 提到 90，其他告警别动。
再把这条内存告警的持续时间从 5m 改成 10m，同样只改这一条。两次改完后告诉我这条规则现在整体长什么样。

alerts/rules.yml.equals:
groups:
- name: host
  rules:
  - alert: HighCPU
    expr: cpu_usage > 80
    for: 5m
  - alert: HighMemory
    expr: mem_usage > 90
    for: 10m
  - alert: DiskFull
    expr: disk_usage > 80
    for: 5m
- name: app
  rules:
  - alert: SlowRequests
    expr: p95_latency > 800
    for: 5m
